title: Solid and Liquid Water on Earth
seo_title: Grade 2 Water on Earth Worksheets: Solid and Liquid Water, Oceans and Glaciers
standard_text: Obtain information to identify where water is found on Earth and that it can be solid or liquid.
meta_desc: Free grade 2 science worksheets on water on Earth (NGSS 2-ESS2-3): solid and liquid water, oceans, lakes, rivers, glaciers and snow. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_big: Water can be solid or liquid.
key_sub: Ice and snow are solid. Oceans, lakes and rain are liquid.
body_html:
How to think about it

Water is all over Earth.

  • Liquid: oceans, lakes, rivers, rain.
  • Solid: ice, snow, glaciers.
  • Most water is in the salty ocean.
Example

Is a glacier solid or liquid?

It is ice.

Answer: solid

Example

Where is most of Earth's water?

Oceans are huge.

Answer: in the oceans

Common mistakes

  • Thinking snow and ice are not water.
  • Thinking most water is in lakes and rivers. Most is in the ocean.
  • Thinking ocean water is good to drink. It is salty.

faq.q: Where is water found on Earth?
faq.a: In oceans, lakes, rivers, ponds and under the ground as liquid, and in glaciers, ice caps and snow as solid.

faq.q: Where is most of Earth's water?
faq.a: In the oceans. Ocean water is salty, so we cannot drink it.
Yes. Snow is solid water. It melts into liquid water when it gets warm.
